preconditions.description: Attacker must control the admin wallet address (_adminWalletAddress) to receive reentrant calls
Contract must hold sufficient tokens to trigger swapAndLiquify (>= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity)
swapAndLiquifyEnabled must be true to allow automatic swap execution

exploit_hint: 1. Ensure attacker controls the _adminWalletAddress (set via _setReceiverWallet by owner). 2. Trigger token transfers to accumulate contract balance >= numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity. 3. Execute a transfer that triggers swapAndLiquify(). 4. During swapTokensForEth() external call to Uniswap router, the contract balance changes. 5. When sendBNBToAdmin() executes address(this).balance transfer to attacker-controlled admin wallet, reenter the contract before balance state is finalized. 6. Extract additional BNB through reentrant calls before the transfer completes.
